name: MATH-A-MOLE
summary: MATH-A-MOLE is a fast-paced and fun educational game where you solve math problems by whacking the correct mole! Equipped with a virtual hammer, you'll enter a colourful arena filled with popping moles, each holding a possible answer. Quick thinking and accurate math skills are your keys to racking up points and beating the clock. Perfect for kids and learners of all ages, MATH-A-MOLE combines arcade action with brain training to make learning math exciting and interactive!
